name: app-property-onboarding-and-login-three-screens-with-layered-photo
title: Three white screens: onboarding with a layered sea-view photo, log in by phone and log in by email with dark social block
whatItIs: A pale grey background with three staggered phones: onboarding with 'UNLOCK OVERSEAS OPPORTUNITIES', a stack of gradient panels and a sea-view window photo and a black Get Started pill; log in by phone with a segmented control, flag field and black Continue plus a dark block of Apple, Facebook, Google and X buttons; and log in by email with email and password fields.
whatItMeans: Clean and modern; black pill buttons and a dark social block create a clear hierarchy.
techniques: Layer gradient panels behind a photo.
Use a segmented control for phone or email.
Contrast a white form with a dark social block.

vocabulary.definition: A photo with gradient panels stacked behind.
A toggle between two input modes.
A black area with sign-in provider buttons.
A phone input with a country flag.
